description: An EBSD inverse-pole-figure (IPF) texture figure, supplied cropped so that only panel (a) is fully visible; the top edge of a second, lower panel labelled "(b) LNT" appears at the very bottom of the image and its content is cut off. Panel (a) is labelled "RT" and is divided into four standard cubic IPF triangles with the corners marked 001 (bottom-left), 101 (bottom-right) and 111 (top). Each triangle is annotated with a strain level — 0 %, 3 %, 28 % and 44 % — and carries its own colour key. Every key runs from 1 (blue, low intensity) upward through green and yellow to red, and prints a maximum: Max=2.55 (0 %), Max=2.74 (3 %), Max=3.16 (28 %) and Max=4.81 (44 %); the 44 % key additionally carries ticks 1, 2, 3 and 4. High-intensity yellow-red regions cluster around the 111 corner, blue (low) regions lie near 001, and green fills much of the triangle interior, with contour lines outlining the gradient. From 0 % to 44 % the red zone at the 111 corner grows and sharpens and the printed maximum rises, so panel (a) demonstrates that room-temperature deformation progressively strengthens a <111>-type texture.

subfigures.description: Row labelled "RT" containing four cubic inverse-pole-figure triangles (001 bottom-left, 101 bottom-right, 111 top) for strain levels 0 %, 3 %, 28 % and 44 %, each with its own colour key printing Max=2.55, 2.74, 3.16 and 4.81 respectively. Intensity concentrates at the 111 corner (yellow-red) and decays toward 001 (blue); the red zone and the printed maximum both grow with strain.

Labelled "LNT" at the bottom of the image; only the very top edge of this row is visible (the "111" corner labels of its triangles), the body, strain labels, colour keys and any values are cropped out of the supplied image.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is labelled "RT", i.e. room temperature, and contains four separate IPF triangles.
The four IPF triangles in (a) are annotated with strain levels 0 %, 3 %, 28 % and 44 %, read left to right.
Each IPF triangle corner is labelled as a crystallographic direction: 001 at bottom-left, 101 at bottom-right and 111 at the top.
Printed maximum intensity values on the colour keys are Max=2.55 (0 %), Max=2.74 (3 %), Max=3.16 (28 %) and Max=4.81 (44 %).
The colour keys use a blue(low)-green-yellow-red(high) scale with tick labels 1 and 2 for the 0 %, 3 % and 28 % keys, and tick labels 1, 2, 3 and 4 for the 44 % key.
High-intensity (yellow-red) regions are localised at the 111 corner of each triangle, while the 001 corner region stays blue (low intensity).
As strain increases from 0 % to 44 % the red high-intensity zone at the 111 corner expands and sharpens, and the printed maximum rises from 2.55 to 4.81.
Contour lines are drawn across the triangles, outlining the intensity gradient between the low-intensity and high-intensity zones.
A second row labelled "(b) LNT" is present at the bottom of the image but only its top edge is rendered; the panel body, strain labels and colour keys are not visible.
No caption text was extracted for this figure, so the panel labels, strain values and maxima listed here are read directly from the pixels.
